thracian_raider: A Thracian raider warrior: wiry and fierce, a fox-skin cap with the ear flaps down, a long cloak of rust-red and ochre zigzag-patterned wool, bare tattooed forearms with blue-black geometric tattoos, leather boots, a crescent-shaped wicker pelta shield, gripping a curved sica blade.
gaulish_raider: A Celtic Gaulish raider: a broad warrior with stiff lime-washed spiky hair and a drooping moustache, bare chest painted with faint woad swirls, checked rust-and-mustard trousers, a bronze neck torc, a tall oval wooden shield with a central iron boss, holding a long iron sword.
scythian_raider: A Scythian steppe raider: a tall pointed felt hood, a belted tunic of dark ochre leather with red felt trim, patterned trousers tucked into soft boots, a gorytos bow case at the hip, swinging a short-handled bronze battle axe, braided dark beard.
illyrian_sea_raider: An Illyrian sea raider (pirate of the Adriatic): a dented bronze Illyrian helmet without crest, a salt-stained crimson tunic, a sheepskin over one shoulder, bare calves, a small round hide shield, a heavy curved falcata blade, rope belt with a dagger.
thracian_chieftain: A Thracian barbarian chieftain: a big imposing warlord, a gilded bronze helmet with embossed eyes and a tall horsehair plume of dark red, a black bear-pelt cloak over a scale-armour corselet, gold arm rings, a long curved two-handed rhomphaia blade.
gaulish_chieftain: A Celtic Gaulish chieftain: a huge warlord with a heavy gold torc and a bronze helmet topped with a spread-winged bird crest, a long crimson cloak fastened with a gold brooch, iron ring-mail shirt, checked trousers, a tall painted oval shield and a long sword, a thick braided moustache.
scythian_chieftain: A Scythian chieftain: a massive steppe king with a tall pointed hood stitched with gold plaques, a scale-armour coat of bronze, a leopard-skin over the shoulders, a gold pectoral collar, a heavy battle axe and a bow case on the hip, long braided beard.
illyrian_chieftain: An Illyrian pirate chieftain: a burly raider captain in a bronze Illyrian helmet with a crest of black boar bristles, a crimson cloak and a bronze muscle cuirass dented from battle, a wolf-pelt mantle, a large round bronze-rimmed shield and a heavy falcata.
